B.name: Dynamite Stick
B.flavour: Light it. Lob it. Count to one.
B.note: B · classic paper stick: dark rings, cream ends, a pale cord fuse; the bundle three sticks in black tape

recipe.subject: The reference image shows the stick of dynamite to draw: keep its shape, parts and colours, the fuse may curl a little longer. A single stick of dynamite: a smooth sandy-brown paper cylinder with two thin dark brown rings near each end and flat cream paper ends, a pale grey cord fuse curling out of its top end with a charred black tip, the fuse lit: a big bright yellow and orange spark burst fizzing at its tip with a few tiny sparks flying off, easy to see, plain paper with no letters, numbers or writing anywhere on it, lying diagonally from the bottom left to the top right with the fuse at the top right
